summary: Iteration-43 review: verified Psychological + Medical Deep Dive Compare pathways, share-link nickname round-trip, and iter-42 regression. Built /app/backend/tests/test_iter43_features.py (18 tests) — 17 pass, 1 SKIP (no CP report seeded for parent1). Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_features.py — 20/20 still pass, confirming the shared-core refactor did not regress the educational-compare flow. LinkIn/ConsentIn module-scope fix verified: both /api/psych-deep/compare/link and /api/med-deep/compare/link accept JSON body (no query-param 422 regression). Frontend: both compare hubs load with correct testids, disclosure modal renders, partner-email input & 'Send compare request' happy path works end-to-end (new share_id returned and appears in list). ReportShareControls nickname input on /summary works: testid=summary-share-nickname-input, maxlength=60, placeholder shown, value round-trips via /share/mine label field.
critical_code_review_comments: deep_dive_compare_router_factory.py cleanly hosts LinkIn/ConsentIn at module scope (lines 54, 58) — the previously-flagged 422 factory-scope bug is fixed and verified by test_link_body_is_json_body_not_query (parametrised across psych/med).

share_routes.record_share_token correctly persists label; ReportShareControls sends {label} in POST body and renders label in row via testid {prefix}-row-label-{jti}. All four share-link endpoints (safety/CP report/mediation summary/mediation agreement) accept the label field.

Both psych/med compare routers use edu_deep_comparison_pdf.build_comparison_pdf for PDF output — acceptable code reuse but note the PDF header uses per-pathway product_title so downstream branding is fine.
psych-deep and med-deep compare hubs share the DeepDiveCompareHub component, so consistent UX + testid prefix is guaranteed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 executed, 1 skipped due to missing seed)

seed_data_creation: None — tests reuse the parent1/parent2 accounts and self-clean any leftover psych/med deep-dive shares via an autouse fixture that mirrors the iter-42 pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-43 shipped three deep-dive-compare pathways on top of deep_dive_comparison_core + deep_dive_compare_router_factory. Any new pathway added must also register its shares_collection in the autouse cleanup fixture of test_iter43_features. Skip on test_coparenting_report_share_link_label is expected in a fresh env — seed a CP report first if you want to cover that path. When testing the safety-assessment nickname flow via UI, note the acknowledgement modal blocks interaction until the checkbox is checked and continue button clicked; use /summary page for a simpler nickname-input smoke path.
